Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 (2023)
cleanIntro: The M&P22 Compact has a FIXED barrel, so the slide lifts at the rear and comes forward off it rather than the barrel coming out of the slide. Deep Clean is the magazine, which the manual documents on its own.

steps.title: 22 LR only — read the marking on the firearm
steps.action: Check what you have been shooting and what is going back in the box. Never use cartridges other than those designated by the marking on the firearm; on this pistol that is 22 LR, and 22 Short, 22 Long or any of the hotter rimfire rounds that will physically enter the chamber are not what it is marked for. Note the model name and serial number marked on your pistol before you start; Smith & Wesson asks owners to record the serial number before shipping a firearm in for service.
steps.prose: Rimfire is where this bites hardest, because a whole family of .22 cartridges shares a case head and will chamber in something not built for them. The manual's own reason is pressure: the wrong type may exceed the capability of your firearm and may damage or even rupture it. Ammunition is also worth thinking about before a clean, because a pistol that has been fed high-velocity waxy bullets leaves far more residue in a blowback action.
steps.quote: NEVER USE CARTRIDGES OTHER THAN THOSE DESIGNATED BY THE MARKING ON THE FIREARM. DOING SO CAN RESULT IN DANGEROUSLY HIGH PRESSURES THAT MAY DAMAGE THE FIREARM AND POSSIBLY CAUSE INJURY TO YOURSELF AND OTHERS.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Ammunition, WARNING, p.9
steps.warn: Never use a cartridge not specifically designated for use in your firearm. The wrong type of ammunition may exceed the capability of your firearm and may damage or even rupture your firearm.

steps.title: Safety up, magazine out, slide back and held open
steps.action: Point the pistol in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger and the trigger fully forward. Verify the manual safety is in the safe up position, press the magazine release and take the magazine out, then draw the slide briskly fully rearward to extract anything in the chamber. With the slide fully rearward, press the slide stop lever up while allowing the slide to move slightly forward — that holds it open in the correct position for disassembly.
steps.prose: Note the wording of the last part: this pistol wants the slide held open in a particular position before the takedown lever will turn, so it is press-up-then-ease-forward, not just thumbing the stop. A .22 LR case is short and light and a slow pull will drag one out of the chamber only to drop it back in the action, so draw the slide briskly and all the way.
steps.quote: With the slide fully rearward, press the slide stop lever up while allowing the slide to move slightly forward. This will hold the slide open in the correct position to allow disassembly (FIGURE 52).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.27

steps.title: Look into the chamber and down the magazine well
steps.action: Look into the chamber and confirm it is empty, then look down through the magazine well and verify no ammunition remains in the pistol. Unload the magazine separately by pressing each cartridge forward and out.
steps.prose: Two checks, because they can disagree — a rimfire case that failed to eject can lie in the frame below the feed ramp, out of sight from the chamber. This pistol also has a magazine disconnect safety, which means it will not fire without a magazine in place; that is not a substitute for clearing the chamber and never has been.
steps.quote: Look into the chamber and down through the magazine well. Verify that no ammunition remains in the pistol
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Unloading, p.25

steps.title: Use the magazine that came with this pistol
steps.action: Keep this pistol's own magazines with it. A magazine from another model may physically insert and will only function properly in the model it was designed for.
steps.prose: On a bench where a .22 trainer sits next to the centrefire pistol it copies, this is a live mistake rather than a theoretical one — the M&P22 Compact is deliberately shaped like its bigger siblings. A wrong magazine that seats and latches will pass every check you can make by hand and fail on the range.
steps.quote: While your magazine may be able to be inserted into another model pistol, it will only function properly in the specific model for which it was designed. Do not interchange magazines from one model pistol into another model pistol.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Loading, p.18

steps.title: Takedown lever clockwise 90 degrees to 6 o'clock — and leave it in the frame
steps.action: With the slide held open, rotate the takedown lever clockwise 90 degrees into the 6 o'clock position. Do not try to pull it out of the frame.
steps.prose: The lever on this pistol is designed to remain captive, which is the opposite of the Bodyguard 380 where the lever is removed entirely — carrying that habit across is how a captive lever gets levered at and broken. Clockwise and a quarter turn, no more; if it will not go, the slide is not being held in the position the previous step set up.
steps.caution: The takedown lever is designed to remain captive. No attempt should be made to remove it from the frame.
steps.quote: Rotate the takedown lever clockwise 90 degrees into the 6 o’clock position (FIGURE 53).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.28

steps.title: Slide back, lift at the rear, then forward off the fixed barrel
steps.action: Pull the slide fully rearward and lift it up at the rear, off the frame. Then, keeping the rear held up, move the slide forward under control until it is clear of the barrel, and set it aside.
steps.prose: This is the step that makes the M&P22 Compact unlike every other M&P: the barrel is fixed to the frame and does not come out of the slide, so the slide has to be lifted at the back and drawn off the barrel forward. Trying to push it straight forward without lifting the rear will simply jam it against the barrel, and the recoil spring assembly is still in tension while you do it.
steps.quote: Pull the slide fully rearward and lift it up at the rear and off the frame (FIGURE 54).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.28

steps.title: Recoil spring and guide rod off the frame
steps.action: Lift the recoil spring and guide rod assembly out of the frame and set it aside.
steps.prose: It comes off the frame here, not out of the slide, because the barrel it sits under is part of the frame. Note the orientation of the sloped surface on the guide rod as it comes out — it only goes back one way, and the slide will not reinstall if it is wrong.
steps.quote: Remove the recoil spring and guide rod assembly from the frame and set them aside (FIGURE 56).
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.28

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Slide, frame with its fixed barrel, recoil spring and guide rod, and magazine — this completes field stripping of the firearm and no further disassembly should be attempted. Never dry fire this pistol at any point; damage to it will result. Deep Clean covers the magazine, which the manual documents on its own.
steps.prose: The dry-fire rule on a rimfire is not a warranty formality — the firing pin strikes the chamber mouth with no case rim to stop it and peens the chamber, and this manual states it flatly for the M&P22 Compact.
steps.quote: This completes field stripping of the firearm. No further disassembly should be attempted.
steps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Field Stripping/Disassembly, p.28

deepSteps.title: Empty the magazine, press the floor plate retainer
deepSteps.action: Remove all cartridges from the magazine before disassembly. Then press the magazine floor plate retainer down with a small screwdriver or punch.
deepSteps.prose: The retainer sits directly under the hole in the floor plate with the spring pushing it up, so the tool has to reach through and hold it down rather than merely touch it. Keep the magazine pointed away from your face from this point.
deepSteps.quote: Press the magazine floor plate retainer down with a small screwdriver or punch (FIGURE 74).
deepSteps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Magazine Disassembly, p.33
deepSteps.warn: The magazine spring is under pressure. Control the spring and floor plate retainer so they do not fly out and cause injury.

deepSteps.title: Floor plate off with the retainer controlled
deepSteps.action: Pull the floor plate off while controlling the floor plate retainer, which is under spring pressure and will otherwise fly out.
deepSteps.prose: The retainer rides on top of the spring and is the part that escapes — the manual's own figure shows it sitting on the spring ready to leave the tube. Take the plate off slowly with a thumb over the opening rather than sliding it off in one movement.
deepSteps.quote: Control the floorplate retainer from flying out under spring pressure as you pull the floor plate off (FIGURE 75).
deepSteps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Magazine Disassembly, p.33

deepSteps.title: Spring out, then the load assist button and follower
deepSteps.action: Take the spring out of the magazine tube. Then slide the magazine load assist button down to the hole at the bottom of the tube and lift it out, which frees the follower to be removed from the bottom of the magazine.
deepSteps.prose: The load assist button — the thumb tab on the side — is what pins the follower, and it will only leave at that one wider hole near the base of the tube. It is keyed to enter the follower from one side in one direction only, so look at how it sits before it comes out. Clean inside the tube while it is open: rimfire lubricant and residue in a .22 magazine is the usual reason the last rounds hang up.
deepSteps.quote: Slide the magazine load assist button down to the hole at the bottom of the magazine tube and lift it out to remove the button. This allows the magazine follower to then be removed from the bottom of the magazine
deepSteps.cite:
Safety & Instruction Manual for     
M&P®22 Compact Pistol — p/n 441930000 REV:M&P22 COMPACT_013023 — Magazine Disassembly, p.33

cleaning.name: BARREL AND CHAMBER
tasks: Remove excessive firing residue from the bore and chamber with a properly fitted brass brush dipped in gun cleaning solvent
Finish by running a dry cotton cloth patch through the bore and chamber to remove residue and solvent
Clean the feed ramp and the outside of the fixed barrel where the slide rides over it
Check the bore is clear before the pistol goes back together

cleaning.name: SLIDE AND FRAME
tasks: Clean the breech face, the extractor and the inside of the slide
Clean the frame rails and around the takedown lever, without attempting to remove the lever
Clean the recoil spring and guide rod assembly and note the orientation of its sloped surface
Clean the exterior with a non-abrasive cleaning cloth and remove all solution, oil and fingerprints

cleaning.name: MAGAZINE
tasks: Wipe the tube, the feed lips and the load assist button slot
If the magazine has been apart, clean the inside of the tube and the follower before reassembly
Check the floor plate is secure before the magazine goes back into service
The magazine button interacts with the slide stop — check for proper function after reassembly

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: A single drop of firearm lubricant at the marked points on each side of the pistol
Do not over-lubricate: excess collects unburned powder and carbon residue and interferes with proper functioning
Avoid prolonged solvent immersion and prolonged ultrasonic cleaning
Never use ammoniated or other strong alkaline solvents on this pistol

reassembly: Make certain the hammer is not in the fired position before assembling — if it is visible above the frame, press it down and rearward into the cocked position, or the slide cannot be installed.
Replace the guide rod assembly into the frame with the sloped surface correctly oriented.
Set the slide onto the barrel from the front with its rear held up, bring it rearward and lower the rear onto the frame.
Rotate the takedown lever back up 90 degrees into its horizontal locked position.
Magazine: install the follower, insert the keyed load assist button into it from the correct side, replace the spring and floor plate retainer, then slide the floor plate on until it is fully seated.
fncheck: With the pistol empty and pointed in a safe direction, confirm the takedown lever is rotated fully back up into its locked position. Cycle the slide by hand several times and check it runs fully into battery and that the slide stop holds it open and releases cleanly. Insert an empty magazine and confirm it latches, drops free on the release, and that the magazine button raises the slide stop as designed. Do not dry fire the pistol to test the trigger — this model must never be dry fired.
